series.name: 5P 650-1550 i (line-interactive UPS, tower/rack/wall)
series.notes: Line-interactive family. The gen-1 5P manual does NOT publish numeric A/F codes - it uses a short 'Operation status' text table that the LCD shows. Do not merge with SERIES 5 (5P Gen2) or with the 9PX table: 5P Gen2 adds explicit LED colours and beeper cadences and renames 'End of battery life' as 'Battery fault'.

meaning.en: The UPS does not recognise the internal batteries, so it has no battery backup.
meaning.ur: UPS ko apni internal batteries nazar nahi aa rahi, is liye us ka koi battery backup nahi hai.

causes.en: The internal battery harness connector is unplugged or not fully seated.
causes.ur: Internal battery harness connector nahi laga ya poori tarah seat nahi hua.

causes.en: The battery pack has been pulled out during a previous service and not refitted.
causes.ur: Battery pack pichli service mein nikal kar wapas nahi lagaya gaya.

causes.en: A battery connector pin is loose, corroded or broken, so the string reads as open.
causes.ur: Battery connector ka pin dhile, zang khaa ya toota hua hai, is liye string khuli nazar aati hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug the mains and wait at least 5 minutes before touching the battery compartment.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery compartment chhoone se pehle kam az kam 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected; push the connector firmly until it latches.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saari batteries theek se juri hain; connector ko latch hone tak mazbooti se push karein.

solutions.en: Measure the internal battery DC voltage with a DMM; an open circuit means the harness or a cell is dead.
solutions.ur: DMM se internal battery ka DC voltage maarein; open circuit ka matlab hai ke harness ya koi cell mar chuka hai.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

meaning.en: Power demand exceeds 105% of the UPS nominal capacity; the unit keeps running but may shut down if load increases.
meaning.ur: Power demand UPS nominal capacity ke 105% se zyada hai; unit chalta rehta hai magar load barhne par band ho sakta hai.

causes.en: More equipment is connected than the 5P is rated for.
causes.ur: 5P ki rating se zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A computer or air conditioner was added to the UPS without a load calculation.
causes.ur: Koi computer ya air conditioner load calculation ke baghair UPS par lagaya gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and unplug the output before disconnecting any load.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi load disconnect karne se pehle UPS band karein aur output nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS until the load percentage on the LCD is under 100%.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage 100% se neeche aane tak UPS se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current with a clamp meter; if the load is permanently over 105%, move it to a larger UPS.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se output current maarein; agar load mustaqil 105% se upar hai to barhe UPS par le jaayein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

title.ur: End of battery life (battery ki umar khatam)

meaning.en: The batteries have reached end of life and can no longer give useful runtime.
meaning.ur: Batteries end of life par aa chuki hain aur ab useful runtime nahi de sakti.

causes.en: The battery string is aged beyond its design life and has lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string apni design life se zyada umar ke baad capacity khoyi chuki hai.

causes.en: The batteries have been kept in a hot environment, which shortens their life by half per 10 degrees C above 25 C.
causes.ur: Batteries garmi mein rahi hain, jis se 25 C se 10 degree upar par har 10 degree par zindagi aadha ho jaati hai.

causes.en: Repeated deep discharges have worn the cells out.
causes.ur: Baar baar gehri discharge ne cells ko kharab kiya hai.

solutions.en: Record the alarm message and the UPS serial number before touching the battery.
solutions.ur: Battery chhoone se pehle alarm message aur UPS serial number likh lein.

solutions.en: Contact your service representative for battery replacement, quoting the serial number.
solutions.ur: Battery tabdeeli ke liye apne service representative se rabta karein aur serial number dein.

solutions.en: After replacement, apply utility power for at least 48 hours and run a battery test before relying on backup.
solutions.ur: Tabdeeli ke baad kam az kam 48 ghante utility power dein aur backup par bharosa karne se pehle battery test chalayein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

meaning.en: A UPS event has occurred. The manual's example is the RPO contact being activated, which shuts the UPS down and now prevents restart.
meaning.ur: Koi UPS event ho gaya hai. Manual ka example hai ke RPO contact activate hua, jo UPS band karta hai aur ab restart nahi hone deta.

causes.en: The Remote Power OFF (RPO) contact has been activated.
causes.ur: Remote Power OFF (RPO) contact activate ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Another event such as a maintenance command or a remote shutdown was received.
causes.ur: Koi doosra event jaise maintenance command ya remote shutdown mila hai.

solutions.en: Set the contact back to its normal position (open, for a normally-closed RPO loop).
solutions.ur: Contact ko us ki normal position par wapas set karein (normally-closed RPO loop ke liye open).

solutions.en: Press the front-panel button to restart the UPS once the contact is released.
solutions.ur: Contact chhodne ke baad UPS restart karne ke liye front panel ka button dabayein.

solutions.en: Investigate why the RPO was triggered (fire alarm loop, building system, accidental press) before clearing it.
solutions.ur: RPO trigger hone ki wajah (fire alarm loop, building system, ghalti se dabana) jaan lein, phir clear karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

meaning.en: The UPS has an internal fault and no longer protects the connected equipment.
meaning.ur: UPS mein internal fault hai aur woh ab connected equipment ki protection nahi kar raha.

causes.en: An internal power stage, relay, or control board failure.
causes.ur: Internal power stage, relay ya control board ki kharabi.

causes.en: A failed battery or charger has dragged the internal rails out of range.
causes.ur: Kharab battery ya charger ne internal rails ko range se bahar kheench diya.

causes.en: Input or output surge has damaged an internal component.
causes.ur: Input ya output surge ne koi internal component damage kar diya.

solutions.en: Note the alarm message and the UPS serial number, then contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: Alarm message aur UPS serial number likh lein, phir apne service representative se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Do not leave the load on this unit: move it to a healthy UPS or a bypass-fed outlet in the meantime.
solutions.ur: Load ko is unit par mat chhodein: us waqt use healthy UPS ya bypass-fed outlet par le jaayein.

solutions.en: Before any repair, switch off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery module with insulated tools.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi tabdeeli se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur insulated tools se battery module disconnect karein.
